CHANGELOG — IRREVERENTS

Shared change history for anyone editing this Google Drive game-design library (ChatGPT, Claude, or a human).

All times America/New_York (EST or EDT as appropriate). Newest entries first.

# How to maintain this log

For EVERY MATERIAL CHANGE in this project folder, AFTER the changed Drive files have actually been saved:

• Add one concise entry at the TOP of the dated entries. Include the actual date and local time with time zone, editor (if known), what changed (1–3 brief sentences), and DIRECT LINKS to every materially affected document, folder, or asset batch.

• Group closely related edits made in one session into a single entry. A new approved decision, revised rule, added level family, added/removed asset, material change of status, or important curation decision is material. Minor spelling or formatting corrections need no entry.

• Explicitly label whether the entry is a confirmed owner decision, a proposal, a correction of an earlier claim, an exploratory asset, or a production-ready/approved asset. Do NOT silently promote suggestions into canon.

• If an old rule is superseded, link to the new controlling specification and say what changed. Older docs may preserve historical text; prefer updating their current summaries rather than piling on contradictory footnotes.

• For assets, include file/folder links, approval state, and whether they are only concept references or usable production assets. Never bulk-import discarded images simply to make the archive look complete.

• Entries record changes that WERE MADE, not work intended or promised. If a write failed or remains unverified, do not record it as completed.

• Keep this changelog in the project ROOT, and keep a link on “00 START HERE.” Other collaborating assistants should use it as a routing index, but updating it is not automatic: the writer making a change must add an entry.

## Cantina, shared party, endless brawl and completion-based pursuit entry

Built the cantina design: all unlocked characters mingle there, tap candidate → tap party member to swap, Smash-style endless KOs/respawns with K/D, many world shortcut doors, lockout during active good-guy pursuit, and a mystery-component completion reward allowing chased entry BUT guards follow in.

## NPC reporting, escalation, and cross-level pursuits

Confirmed exactly three general NPC modes; good-guy distress can rapidly reverse, but violent mode requires full disengagement and incident-free cooldown. All scaling reinforcements require a completed signal. Villain outpost signalers can be used in Business as Usual upon threat recognition. Guards can pursue into hostile levels and fight villain factions. No NPC AI.
